faqChatbot.title: DeutschUp Assistant
faqChatbot.welcomeMsg: Hallo! I am the DeutschUp virtual assistant. How can I help you with courses, exercises, or subscription plans today?
faqChatbot.suggestion1: What is in the A1 learning path?
faqChatbot.suggestion3: How do I pay with VietQR?
faqChatbot.errorReply: Sorry, a connection error occurred. Please try again in a moment.
faqChatbot.answer1: The DeutschUp path starts from A1.1 to B1, including visual vocabulary, flashcards, interactive exercises, and an AI German conversation practice room.
faqChatbot.answer2: The Premium plan unlocks all comprehensive lessons, listening exercises, AI conversation features, and unlimited grammar checks.
faqChatbot.answer3: Simply select a plan on the Pricing page, then scan the VietQR code using any banking app. The system will activate your plan automatically within seconds.
faqChatbot.defaultAnswer: Thank you for asking! The DeutschUp team is always here to assist. Feel free to check our Pricing page or ask more specific questions.
